description: Reach a loopback service (the radio TCP proxy, 5051, has no authentication) or any socket from a rebuilt _socket: IPv4 127.0.0.1, IPv6 ::1, an abstract Unix socket, and a socketpair (no audit event). The hook refuses the import or the socket.__new__ event; past it, the runner's seccomp filter answers EPERM to socket and socketpair at every level, setuid included, where no network namespace exists (MSHL-415).
